themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Push or pop-up notification behavior, including whether they can be turned off in app settings, their frequency, and whether they dismiss after being opened or display correctly in the status bar.

themes.name: Live station streaming
themes.description: Connecting to and playing live radio streams of local and other NPR stations, including buffering, dropped connections, stations missing from the list, and streams that will not play.

themes.name: Audio playback reliability
themes.description: Playback of stories, podcasts, and hourly news, such as skipping, cutting out, starting mid-story, 'unable to play media' or 'no audio available' errors, and playback that stops or restarts unexpectedly.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Adding, ordering, removing, and keeping stories in the playlist or queue, including playlists that vanish after closing the app or updates, and difficulty finding or playing the playlist.

themes.name: Offline listening
themes.description: Requests or complaints about downloading or caching audio and articles for use without a data connection or while commuting.

themes.name: App stability and crashes
themes.description: Crashes, freezes, force closes, glitches, and compatibility problems with specific devices or OS updates, including screen-flashing loops with the lock screen.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: The app running, starting itself, or staying in the notification area in the background, plus battery and data drain, and the lack of a way to close it.

themes.name: Ads
themes.description: Banner, pop-up, and full-screen advertisements, including ads that cannot be closed, cover article text, or take up screen space.

themes.name: Screen rotation and tablet support
themes.description: Lack of landscape or auto-rotate mode, tablet layout, font size and zoom options, and other display-orientation or accessibility needs.

themes.name: Design and interface
themes.description: Visual design, look and feel, ease of navigation, and layout of the app, including how dated it looks, Material Design, and iOS-versus-Android design.

themes.name: Programs and podcast catalog
themes.description: Availability and discoverability of shows, podcasts, and past episodes, such as missing programs, stale or outdated episodes, and difficulty browsing or loading more.

themes.name: News content and freshness
themes.description: Quality, breadth, accuracy, and timeliness of the stories and articles in the app, including outdated or rarely refreshed content and stories that fail to load.

themes.name: Article display issues
themes.description: Problems displaying article text and media in the app, such as garbled or doubled text, missing images, tweets, or videos, and jittery scrolling.

themes.name: Bias and trust
themes.description: Opinions on NPR's political slant, objectivity, trustworthiness, and credibility as a news source.

themes.name: Widget and external controls
themes.description: Home screen widget functionality, lock screen and notification-bar playback controls, and casting support such as Chromecast.

themes.name: Privacy and permissions
themes.description: Concerns about permissions requested, personal data collection, and location or phone access.

themes.name: Developer responsiveness and updates
themes.description: How actively the app is maintained, whether updates fix or break things, and the ability to contact support or give feedback.
